newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Handy Index fell 11 points to 1,071.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Handy Index fell 11 points to 1,071.

text.p: The Baltic Handy Index for Handy size shipping rates fell to 1,071 on Thursday from 1,082 on May 20, with the base being Jan 7 1997 equals 1000. The BHI is based on the following routes with rates in dollars/tonne.

Note - The Index initially to be published each Tuesday and Thursday is derived from four Handymax time charter routes based on the 'Baltic Handy Max', a modern 43,000 DWT vessel with 25 ton cranes. The Baltic Exchange will also publish returns on two other trial routes alongside the Index. They may be included in it at a later date.
